entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Ancient alien beings native to the Blind Eternities who travel between planes devouring mana and life energy, whose colorless nature marks them as alien.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: A colorless elder dragon planeswalker whose colorlessness reflects his ancientness and transcendence beyond the colors.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes where the Eldrazi originate.

entities.name: Wastes
entities.description: Barren land left behind where the Eldrazi sap magical color, producing colorless mana.

events.summary: The Eldrazi travel from plane to plane, draining the color and energy from the lands they devour and leaving Wastes behind.
events.quote: This sapping of energy drains its magical color and leaves behind Wastes

relations.note: The Eldrazi are native to the Blind Eternities.
relations.quote: The Eldrazi are native to the Blind Eternities

relations.note: Like the Eldrazi, Ugin is colorless because of his ancient origin.
relations.quote: The elder dragon planeswalker Ugin is also colorless
